home.description: Workspace Library overview at /library/ag with search, view/sort controls, collections/drafts, and the persistent left navigation rail.

nodes.title: Theme
nodes.notes: Applies immediately to the whole app; shortcut shown as Shift+Command+\.

nodes.title: Agent Fast Mode default
nodes.notes: Shown when Agent model is Opus 5.

nodes.title: Agent effort picker
nodes.notes: Open by clicking current Agent effort value; selection applies immediately as default for new agent chats.

nodes.title: Brand Kit
nodes.notes: Workspace brand defaults; internal category rail.

nodes.title: Brand options
nodes.notes: Default brand: Rename, Duplicate, New, Archive. Non-default brand additionally offers Make Default.

nodes.title: New Brand
nodes.notes: Immediately creates and opens an Untitled Brand.

nodes.title: Rename Brand
nodes.notes: Enters inline heading edit; commit with Done.

nodes.title: scratch-brand-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch brandId 240; cleanup item.

nodes.title: Template Editor
nodes.notes: Created from Brand Kit > Templates > New Template; URL /template-editor/{id}.

nodes.title: scratch-template-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch; cleanup item, template id 1081.

nodes.title: scratch-template-duplicate-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch cleanup item, template id 1082.

nodes.title: scratch-workflow-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch workflow; cleanup item.

nodes.title: Layout notes
nodes.notes: Freeform notes; edits are staged until Save Changes.

nodes.title: Misc notes
nodes.notes: Freeform notes; edits are staged until Save Changes.

nodes.title: Draft editor
nodes.notes: Full editor at /ag-editor/{id}; Agent/Script modes, canvas, timeline, scenes, project controls.

nodes.title: scratch-draft-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch draft ID 1313689723; cleanup item.

nodes.title: Screen clip settings
nodes.notes: Per-draft override panel; click top-right globe-like icon; Done closes.

nodes.title: scratch-draft-copy-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch cleanup item, id 763129139.

nodes.title: Script scene block
nodes.notes: Add scene appends immediately; each block has title, script entry area and Delete.

nodes.title: Media Gen composer
nodes.notes: Bottom composer mode with Image, Video and Gemini controls.

nodes.title: Voice picker
nodes.notes: Tabs English, World, Creative; selectable voice names; Default Speed control.

nodes.title: Voice selection
nodes.notes: Choosing a voice applies immediately and closes picker.

nodes.title: Add Music
nodes.notes: Only control is Upload background track; supported formats MP3/WAV/M4A.

nodes.title: Upload background track
nodes.notes: Opens native file chooser; MP3/WAV/M4A.

nodes.title: Collection view
nodes.notes: Per-workspace collection; current owned scratch collection at /library/collection/1928638142.

nodes.title: Your Drafts
nodes.notes: Workspace draft-only overview at /library/drafts.

nodes.title: Draft card actions
nodes.notes: Move to collection, Add to Collection, Rename, Make a copy, Delete.

nodes.title: Collection picker
nodes.notes: Selecting a collection applies immediately and closes.

nodes.title: Sort
nodes.notes: Unlabeled icon near Grid/List; choice applies immediately.

nodes.title: Collection options menu
nodes.notes: Contains only Delete Collection.

nodes.title: Delete Collection
nodes.notes: Destructive; do not use on user collections.

nodes.title: New in Collection
nodes.notes: Immediately creates and opens a normal draft editor, associated with the current collection.

nodes.title: scratch-collection-draft-grounding-2026-a1
nodes.notes: Owned scratch created from collection; cleanup item; draft id 1109041657.

nodes.title: Playback
nodes.notes: Unlabeled play/pause transport beside timecode; toggles local preview.

nodes.title: Add Size
nodes.notes: Appends sequential Custom N row with editable name and dimensions defaulting to 1440x897.

nodes.title: Team member actions
nodes.notes: Open member-row ellipsis; selecting Suspend user changes account membership/status.

nodes.title: Upgrade Plans
nodes.notes: Pricing modal from Settings > Upgrade.

nodes.title: Upgrade
nodes.notes: Externally consequential purchase/contact actions; do not commit during exploration.

nodes.title: Sign in with Figma
nodes.notes: No in-page change when clicked; likely external auth.

nodes.title: Sign in with Google
nodes.notes: No in-page change when clicked; likely external auth.

nodes.title: Connect Notion
nodes.notes: No in-page change when clicked; likely external auth.

nodes.title: Import
nodes.notes: No driveable in-page change when clicked; likely native file/import flow.

nodes.title: Library Draft Card Actions
nodes.notes: Menu on each draft row/card in Library.

nodes.title: Make Private Draft
nodes.notes: Applies immediately; reverse label likely Make Public/Make Workspace Draft.

nodes.title: Rename draft inline
nodes.notes: Card ellipsis > Rename; inline textbox appears with current full title selected; Escape cancels.

nodes.title: Version History
nodes.notes: Top-right panel listing timestamp/author versions; selecting one is for reverting. Close button dismisses.

nodes.title: Draft brand assignment
nodes.notes: Project actions > hover Brand; menu also has Edit Brands…

nodes.title: Copy Transcript
nodes.notes: Copies transcript locally; no visible confirmation observed.

nodes.title: Overlay Insert menu
nodes.notes: Options: Text, Image, Video, Icon, Rectangle, Ellipse, Polygon, Line, Arrow, Pen, Group; most are accessibility-unlabeled.

nodes.title: Timeline media panel
nodes.notes: Opened by picture-stack timeline icon; blank in scratch workspace, with bottom upload icon likely opening native file chooser.

nodes.title: Record Camera / Screen
nodes.notes: No in-page effect under CDP; likely native recorder/permission flow.

nodes.title: Record Talk Track
nodes.notes: Shortcut T; no in-page effect under CDP, likely native microphone/recording flow.

nodes.title: Timeline Zoom
nodes.notes: Click to reveal slider; modifying it reveals Reset.

nodes.title: Delete draft
nodes.notes: Final unlabeled Project actions item; immediate deletion and navigation to Library, no confirmation observed.

nodes.title: Default Brand assignment
nodes.notes: Selecting an item applies immediately; parent Project actions label updates.

nodes.title: Edit Brands…
nodes.notes: Navigation control in the document Brand submenu; opens Brand Kit, but not reliably the currently assigned brand.

edges.action: enter a name and click "Create Workspace"
click current Agent model value (for example "Fable 5")
click the current effort value (for example, “Low”)
click “Brand Kit” in the workspace sidebar
choose `New Brand` (immediate creation), then Brand options > Rename Brand, fill Brand name, click Done
click "Duplicate Template", then rename the opened Untitled copy
fill Name, Description, Workflow instructions; click "Done"
click a color swatch / "Open paint picker"
click the top-right globe-like Screen Recording Settings icon
click Project actions (ellipsis beside voice/wave icon)
click Make a copy; duplicate opens immediately
click Composer actions (plus at bottom composer)
open Composer actions and click Switch to Agent
click `Select voice` near the draft title
click a collection card; current scratch collection appears in Library
click `Your Drafts` in the left sidebar
click `Make a copy`; new copy opens in editor
click the unlabeled sort icon beside Grid/List
click New in Collection; rename the Untitled draft and press Enter
click unlabeled play button left of timecode
scroll to Workspace settings, click Add Size
scroll to Team Members and click member-row ellipsis
choose a plan's Upgrade or Book a Call action
click `Sign in with Figma` under Integrations
click `Sign in with Google` under Google Slides
click the A-card timeline toolbar icon (tooltip `Add Overlay`)
Choose `New Blank Overlay`, then click `Insert` above the canvas.
Click the picture-stack icon immediately right of Add Overlay in the timeline toolbar.
click final unlabeled menu item (Delete); immediate destructive action
